04445 Malkam {mal-kawm'} 或 Milkowm {mil-kome'}

源自 04428 用於 04432; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Milcom 3, Malcham 1; 4

米勒公,瑪勒堪 = "偉大的王"
1) 亞捫人的神
2) 便雅憫人沙哈連和其妻賀得所生的兒子 (瑪拉干 #代上 8:9|)
record.edic_text:
04445 Malkam {mal-kawm'} or Milkowm {mil-kome'}

from 04428 for 04432;; n pr m

AV - Milcom 3, Malcham 1; 4

Milcom = "great king"
1) the god of the Ammonites and Phoenicians to whom some Israelites
   sacrificed their infants in the valley of Hinnom
   1a) also 'Molech'
2) a Benjamite, son of Shaharaim by his wife Hodesh
